            id, form_id, invited_email, role, status, token_hash,
            recipient_user_id, recipient_sharing_public_key,
            encrypted_form_data_key, encrypted_form_private_key, expires_at
         ) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'pending', $5, $6, $7, $8, $9,
                   now() + interval '1 hour')
